entries.subject: diyom daa

spans.text: Te o wa pɛ, lingi cio o “ONU” bɛnda bɛndo ni, mi ndaa yɔngu diyom daa a n’cio wanathyéo kadaa, ma ciɛucɛu ndu mi siingu wanapɔnɔn a wanalanɔn vellaa velle,

spans.text: yiyan kudaa wanda tu, a Mɛ lingdon le cio nufia wo o benda naan ni, miyonda kon wa bɛ tu le bol, le lɔɔ lɔɔ, o kon kɔɔly mɛ mi bɛtu kinding a kalando kɔɔly a kaala kɛndan kɔɔly le hakilan lan a malaa thɛuthɛuvo le kɔlan laci, o kon ni mi bɛɛlen le tosang o lingi nayini a lingy kɛkɛ cio o kundaa kalaa ni.

entries.description: nɔn yiyando a kullo
entries.subject: nɔn yiyando

spans.text: wanda tu cio Mɛ pilɔɔ o wolɔɔ ni, le waa o ba ndɔɔ cio, o bɛɛlen kenando ni, o tɔngdo ni, bɛtu nɔn yiyando a kullo, o kon ni naan tu dua mim maalyan kalapilɔyɛyi ni.

entries.subject: biyɔɔ pilɔ

spans.text: bɛtu cio biyɔɔ pilɔ ni tɔngdo hɔl, mo mala wɛlɛ bɛtu, wanna fisa wɛlɛ cian tɛ ndo hɔl.

entries.description: lingi nduwɛy ni fuu
entries.subject: lingi nduwɛy

spans.text: wanna bi tyandɔ lende naa le, ma loyɛi ndu o kaaso ni, ma tow ndu o lingi nduwɛy ni fuu.

entries.description: haki dɔ a yaala dɔ sina
entries.subject: haki dɔ

spans.text: kangalan mɛɛ mi suwɛyi wanacieo wa o diyandaa, mo wa wagba diiyo kɔɔly o ciɛyi kitiyo ni, le haki dɔ a yaala dɔ sina.

entries.description: suɛyi playe ni te
entries.subject: suɛyi playe

spans.text: wanna doi ma lɔyi o suɛyi playe ni te, o wa pɛ suɛyi pulalen ndɔlen pɛ, o wa pɛ sun dɔ vinan wɛlɛ pɛ, a sun lungdo wɛlɛ pɛ, o doi ma sɔla kul palaa kɛ kɛ o lan ning te, te kun wa pɛ, tɔngdo doi kada bɛ tu o sun wa lende ni.

entries.description: wɛlɛ pɛ a doi ma thianun don
entries.subject: wɛlɛ pɛ

spans.text: kɔlan nga hɔnɔɔ kumbiya wagba le bɛ tu o lingden ni, naa naa nyɛnan wɛlɛ pɛ a doi ma thianun don.

entries.description: lingy cielen ni le kidaa sɔlaa
entries.subject: lingy cielen

spans.text: Te sɔn delɔɔcio ying pɛ, a tiuba ma kuwɛ o lingy cielen ni le kidaa sɔlaa, wanaa kan dua ma kɛɛ num te.

entries.description: du polelingdo sɔlaa le
entries.subject: du polelingdo

spans.text: wanna kuuna du polelingdo sɔlaa le, o kon ni, o tiwba mo sɔlaa poleling dole lingden ciɛlen.

entries.subject: pɛ kundaa

spans.text: wanna wa pɛ kundaa tɛn pɛ, te o cio kon te, mo wa wanapilɛyɛi ni, o nɔn hakiyo le sɔla le ndu pla.

entries.description: o kundaa ni kalan te

entries.description: tiu wanaabaara a Mugu do
entries.subject: tiu wanaabaara

spans.text: baara dua mo sarang, sara dua mo tiu wanaabaara a Mugu do,

entries.description: baara kɔɔli a baara tosa pɛɛngo bɛngu
entries.subject: baara kɔɔli

spans.text: bɛtu nɔn hakiyo le pɛngiyo o baara ni, mo pisulu baara kɔɔli a baara tosa pɛɛngo bɛngu, ma sara ndu wɛlɛ pɛngu pɛngiyo bɛngu, o nda weelu naa “congé”

entries.description: le sew sɔlaa o cɛucɛu yugu dɔɔ
entries.subject: le sew

spans.text: bɛtu nɔn hakiyo le sew sɔlaa o cɛucɛu yugu dɔɔ, le ciɛn kɛndɔɔ tosaa, le kɛndiya, Mɛdiya, worolan, cɛyi lɔlaa, a ndu pla dandaa dɔwɔɔ.

entries.description: kalan tasoo a o din dɔɔ
entries.subject: kalan tasoo

spans.text: bɛtu nɔn hakiyo kalando, mi kalan kon doi mo wa wɛlɛ fondoo, le kalan tasoo a o din dɔɔ, kalan la lan doi ma kangalan le bɛtu.

spans.text: karantaa doi mo mala wana thyeu, le wanayɛyi nduɛyi yowɔɔ lathi, le waa o ba ndɔ cio yowɔɔ laci, o doi mo tosa saboo le nɛyɔn wɔɔndo malɔɔ, mo tosa wɛlɛ mi Miyɛ a canjan luɛyi ceedo ni suulan tɛ, diinalan wanda tɛ, ma mala wɛlɛ kundaa bɛndo “ONU” le bɛnda lɔyɔɔ o ciɛdo ni,
